ACXDNodeStep.description: One planned step of a flow, with its determinism decision.

description.description: What happens at this step, in plain language
description.title: Description

determinism_rationale.description: Why this label was recommended, in plain language
determinism_rationale.title: Determinism Rationale

decision_category.description: What the step decides; one of ('authorization', 'compliance', 'eligibility', 'identity', 'money', 'payment', 'refund', 'general'). Money/refund/payment/authorization/eligibility/compliance/identity steps are always deterministic.
decision_category.title: Decision Category

data_request_id.description: For data_request steps: the Data Request to call. Defaults to the flow's operation_id (one Data Request per operation).
data_request_id.title: Data Request Id

redirect_flow_id.description: For redirect steps: the flow_id this step hands the conversation to (e.g. the customer-info search flow when the order number is not found). The generated flow must redirect there; system hand-offs (follow-up, escalation) need not be named.
redirect_flow_id.title: Redirect Flow Id

captures.description: generative_journey steps only: names of the flow's slots the journey collects in free conversation (e.g. ['reason', 'preferredDate']). A value with a strict format — a regex, a phone number, an identifier — is never captured here: it gets its own user_choice step, which the runtime checks character by character.
captures.title: Captures

slot.description: user_choice steps: the flow slot this step collects (e.g. 'orderNumber'). Required for a strict-format slot when the flow also has a generative_journey, so the plan shows which values stay deterministic.
slot.title: Slot

journey_tools.description: generative_journey steps only: 'knowledge_base' lets the journey answer side questions from the FAQ knowledge base while it collects values.
journey_tools.title: Journey Tools

template.description: The exact sentence the customer approved for this step, with placeholders: for a basic / generative_text result step the announcement ("예약이 접수되었습니다. 예약번호는 {createReservation.reservationId:NLX.Variable}이며 …" — for a generative_text it is the deterministic fallback spoken when the workspace has no model), for a generative_journey the read-back of the captured values. Propose one in the customer's register, ask once whether to keep it or change it, and store what they approved; the generator uses it verbatim.
template.title: Template

confirmation_pending_reason.description: Set when a re-upsert changed the decision and reset confirmation
confirmation_pending_reason.title: Confirmation Pending Reason

ACXDNodeStep.title: ACXDNodeStep

field_name.description: OperationSpec input field this slot fills (constraints come from its FieldSpec)
field_name.title: Field Name

description: Interview-level plan for one ACXD flow (before node-graph generation).

display_name.description: Short customer-facing name of the operation in the project language (2-4 words, e.g. '배송 조회'); spoken verbatim when the assistant lists what it can help with
display_name.title: Display Name

customer_initiated.description: False for an operation the customer never asks for by itself — e.g. recording the call result after a conversation — that other flows reach by redirect. Such a flow is left out of the greeting/re-guide menu and is not an intent-routing target
customer_initiated.title: Customer Initiated

operation_id.description: OperationSpec this flow implements (required when role='operation')
operation_id.title: Operation Id

confirmed.description: User approved the whole flow plan
confirmed.title: Confirmed

title: ACXDFlowPlan
